stage: HISTORIE (engine stage 6) - fractal axis + competing frames - cache
disputedNote: Even where this story begins is disputed - picking a start date is itself a position. Frames change emphasis and annotation, never the record.

frames.label: Jun 2026 Kazan summit
frames.note: Under this frame the story begins with the ASEAN-Russia Commemorative Summit in Kazan in June 2026, where Marcos met Putin, Vietnam discussed cooperation, and 24 Filipinos were released. This is the frame Philippine and Russian state outlets open with, reading the moment as a fresh diplomatic engagement on its own terms.

frames.label: Feb 2022 Ukraine invasion
frames.note: Under this frame the story begins with Russia's February 2022 invasion of Ukraine, which made every subsequent Russian summit an act of breaking isolation. This is the frame Kyiv Independent, Ukrainian outlets, and G7-aligned commentators open with, reading the Kazan meetings as sanctions-evasion outreach rather than routine diplomacy.

bands.label: Kazan summit window
bands.summary: ASEAN-Russia Commemorative Summit convenes in Kazan with bilateral meetings, prisoner releases, and Vietnam-Russia and Philippines-Russia talks alongside ongoing war reporting from Ukraine.

nodes.title: Vietnam and Russia discuss cooperation on Kazan summit sidelines
nodes.what: Vietnam's Foreign Ministry confirmed that delegations from Hanoi and Moscow held talks on the future of bilateral cooperation during the ASEAN-Russia Commemorative Summit in Kazan. The Vietnamese readout described continuing economic and political engagement between the two governments.

nodes.title: Slovak PM Fico says EU urgently needs diplomatic channel with Russia
nodes.what: Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico said the European Union urgently needs a diplomatic channel of communication with Russia, framing dialogue as a practical necessity. His comments were reported as Russia hosted ASEAN leaders in Kazan.
nodes.disputed: TASS presented the statement as evidence that EU unity on isolating Moscow is eroding; Brussels-aligned outlets typically describe Fico's positions as a minority view within the bloc.

nodes.title: Putin orders release of 24 Filipinos detained in Russia
nodes.what: President Vladimir Putin ordered the release of 24 Filipino nationals held in Russia following Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s appeal during their bilateral meeting in Kazan. Marcos described the outcome publicly and said an oil supply agreement with Russia had not yet been concluded.

nodes.title: Russia restates support for Cuba through Kazan diplomacy
nodes.what: Russia's ambassador to Havana said Moscow will continue to support Cuba, including food aid delivered through UN programs. The remarks were issued as Russia used the Kazan summit window to highlight ties with non-aligned partners beyond ASEAN.

nodes.title: Marcos and Putin discuss energy security in Kazan bilateral
nodes.what: On the sidelines of the ASEAN-Russia Commemorative Summit, Philippine President Marcos met President Putin with energy security among the announced talking points. Manila said the Philippines has not yet sealed an oil deal with Russia, and the Filipino prisoner release was tied to the same meeting.
nodes.disputed: Philippine and Russian state outlets describe the encounter as a productive bilateral on energy and consular matters; G7-aligned and Ukrainian commentators describe it as part of Russia's effort to break post-2022 diplomatic isolation.

nodes.title: Russia and Laos hold active phase of Laros-2026 exercise
nodes.what: Russia's Defense Ministry announced that Russian and Laotian forces had entered the active phase of the joint Laros-2026 military exercise. The drill ran in parallel with the ASEAN-Russia summit week and was framed by Moscow as routine defense cooperation with a Southeast Asian partner.

bands.label: Post-invasion isolation push
bands.summary: Russia faces Western sanctions and diplomatic isolation after invading Ukraine, prompting outreach to ASEAN, Africa, Cuba, and other non-aligned partners to sustain trade and political ties.

nodes.title: Russia launches full-scale invasion of Ukraine
nodes.what: Russian forces crossed into Ukraine from multiple directions, opening the largest land war in Europe since 1945. The United States, European Union, United Kingdom, Canada, Japan, and Australia answered within days with sweeping sanctions on Russian banks, central bank reserves, oligarchs, and energy exports. The UN General Assembly passed Resolution ES-11/1 on March 2 demanding withdrawal, with 141 states in favor.

nodes.title: ICC issues arrest warrant for Vladimir Putin
nodes.what: The International Criminal Court issued a warrant for Russian president Vladimir Putin over the alleged unlawful deportation of children from occupied Ukraine. The warrant legally constrained Putin's travel to ICC member states and shaped which summits he could attend in person. Russia rejected the court's jurisdiction and called the warrant void.

nodes.title: Moscow Victory Day parade hosts foreign leaders
nodes.what: Russia marked the 80th anniversary of victory in World War II with a Red Square parade attended by Chinese president Xi Jinping, Brazilian president Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, and leaders from several Central Asian and CIS states. The lineup was the largest foreign turnout at a Moscow Victory Day in years and was used to signal continued partnerships despite the war in Ukraine. Ukrainian officials denounced participating leaders as endorsing the invasion.
